sessions.speaker: gabrijelcic
sessions.title: Delphi Bugs Meet AI
sessions.summary: A hands-on seminar on finding and fixing hard Delphi bugs with an AI assistant at your side: what it is good at, where it misleads you, and how to keep it honest.

sessions.speaker: barazzetta
sessions.title: Debugging with Claude Code: a practical framework
sessions.summary: A repeatable way to hand a debugging session to Claude Code: reproducing, narrowing down, verifying the fix, and the guard rails that keep a coding agent useful.

sessions.speaker: minuti
sessions.title: Build an MCP server with MCPConnect
sessions.summary: From an empty project to a Model Context Protocol server: tools, resources, prompts, authentication, and testing it against a real client.

sessions.speaker: lastrucci
sessions.title: Server-side web pages with WebStencils
sessions.summary: Template-driven pages from Delphi data: layouts, partials, loops and forms, with a working site at the end of the afternoon.

sessions.speaker: cantu
sessions.title: KAI: a new chapter for Delphi
sessions.summary: The opening keynote: where Delphi is heading and what KAI changes for the people who build with it.

sessions.speaker: rossi
sessions.title: Delphi & AI: where do we stand
sessions.summary: A tour of what is practical today for Delphi developers using AI: coding assistants, agents, MCP, and calling models from your own applications.

sessions.speaker: gabrijelcic
sessions.title: From 32 to 64 bit: what actually breaks
sessions.summary: Migration notes from real code bases: pointer and integer sizes, packed records, inline assembler, and the bugs that only show up on Win64.

sessions.speaker: basile
sessions.title: Semantic search and vector databases in Delphi
sessions.summary: Embeddings, similarity and a vector store, wired into a Delphi application to search by meaning instead of by keyword.

sessions.speaker: breveglieri
sessions.title: Taming a legacy code base, one unit at a time
sessions.summary: Practical steps to put tests and structure around old Delphi code without stopping feature work.

sessions.speaker: fierens
sessions.title: Grid solutions for Delphi web apps
sessions.summary: Data grids for web front ends built with Delphi: sorting, paging, editing, and how far a grid can go before it needs a different design.

sessions.speaker: sbanchi
sessions.title: Delphi on Linux64 in production
sessions.summary: What it takes to ship a Delphi service on Linux: deployment, logging, memory, and the differences that bite after the first demo.

sessions.speaker: minuti
sessions.title: MCPConnect: give your Delphi application to the AI
sessions.summary: An introduction to the Model Context Protocol and to MCPConnect, with real code that exposes your own data and operations to an AI client.

sessions.speaker: carlomagno
sessions.title: Shipping a FireMonkey app to the stores
sessions.summary: The road from a working prototype to an approved iOS and Android release: signing, review rounds, and what to prepare early.

sessions.speaker: bossoni
sessions.title: Continuous integration for Delphi, without the pain
sessions.summary: A small build pipeline that compiles, tests and packages a Delphi project on every commit.

sessions.speaker: daldosso
sessions.title: One code base, five platforms: a field report
sessions.summary: What stayed shared and what had to be written per platform in a real multi-device Delphi project.

sessions.speaker: glienke
sessions.title: Generics and interfaces: patterns that scale
sessions.summary: Where generics and interfaces pay off in a large code base, and the compiler corners to stay out of.

sessions.speaker: lastrucci
sessions.title: A Delphi back end for a modern web front end
sessions.summary: Serving a JavaScript front end from Delphi: REST design, authentication, and keeping both sides in step.
